$comment: Baseline of connectors KNOWN to be gapped on AGENTS.md security invariant #6 (they return external/attacker-controllable text without an <untrusted-content> envelope). Discovered by the Phase-2 sweep in docs/plans/260611_fox3490-untrusted-envelopes/ (FOX-3490). These are tracked, not accepted: each is to be remediated in its own `mcp:release` (FOX-3490 follow-up epic). The check-untrusted-coverage.mjs gate lets these PASS so it does not go red across the repo on day one, while FAILING any NEW network-touching connector that is neither enveloped nor explicitly exempt. RATCHET: when a baselined connector is fixed (reaches an envelope), the gate FAILS until it is removed from gappedConnectors here — so this list can only shrink. EVERY connector in this list trips the gate's network-egress heuristic for the RIGHT reason (direct fetch/HTTP/SDK, shared Microsoft Graph client, or child_process subprocess) — none is here merely because the detector is blind to it, so the ratchet can actually fire when each is enveloped. retell-ai is deliberately NOT listed: it is being enveloped + released in the same FOX-3490 program.

exemptConnectors.google-analytics: Returns GA4 dimension values (page paths/countries/devices = structural), numeric metrics, and internal-authored admin config names. No third-party narrative text.
exemptConnectors.gamma: Generation connector — returns only task/generation IDs, status, and asset URLs. No external text echoed.
exemptConnectors.napkin: Generation connector — returns only generation IDs/status/asset URLs.
exemptConnectors.kling: Generation connector — returns only task IDs/status/asset URLs.
exemptConnectors.runway: Generation connector — returns only task IDs/status/asset URLs.
exemptConnectors.nano-banana: Generation connector — returns only task IDs/status/asset URLs.
exemptConnectors.openai-image: Generation connector — returns only IDs/status/asset URLs or binary image data.
exemptConnectors.opus-video-clip: Generation connector — returns only IDs/status/asset URLs.
exemptConnectors.workday: Field-allowlist (pickFields, types.ts) — id/descriptor/email/businessTitle/isManager/yearsOfService/href only; no free-text surfaces.
exemptConnectors.humaans: Field-allowlist (compactPerson/sanitizePerson, people.ts) — strips to a fixed non-free-text shape.

exemptNote: exemptConnectors are connectors that trip the static network heuristic (they call fetch) but were reviewed in the FOX-3490 sweep and confirmed to return NO model-visible external/attacker-controllable text. This is the in-repo equivalent of a per-file `// untrusted-content-exempt:` marker, used because editing each connector's own source was out of scope for the FOX-3490 prevention-machinery change. If such a connector later starts returning external text, move it to gappedConnectors (or envelope it).

evidence.hubspot: P0 — raw JSON.stringify of CRM objects + conversation messages (server.ts:640).
evidence.outreach: P0 — formatResource spreads email bodies/subjects raw.
evidence.office: P0 — full document/spreadsheet content via toMcpResult JSON.stringify.
evidence.fathom: P0 — meeting transcripts/summaries/speaker names (caller-controllable, same class as retell-ai).
evidence.browser-automation: P0 — scraped accessibility tree / page text = the open web. Reaches external text by `execFile`-ing a local CLI that drives a real browser. The network heuristic now flags this via its child_process/execFile signals, so the ratchet WILL fire once it is enveloped.
evidence.mixmax: P1 — message subject/recipients, meeting/sequence/snippet names + bodies raw.
evidence.elevenlabs: P1 — voice names/descriptions + transcribed audio text (transcription.ts:122).
evidence.quickbooks: P2 — DisplayName, CustomerMemo, invoice line descriptions.
evidence.xero: P2 — item descriptions, contact names, raw Invoice/Contact SDK objects.
evidence.talentlms: P2 — course descriptions, full user profile objects.
evidence.vanta: P2 — remediation_note, vendor descriptions, raw control/evidence objects.
evidence.apple-shortcuts: P2 — shortcut stdout (arbitrary user-shortcut output). Reaches external data by `spawn`-ing the `shortcuts` CLI. The network heuristic now flags this via its child_process/spawn signals, so the ratchet WILL fire once it is enveloped.
